description: This Java source file defines the 'LoginEvents' class which handles user login and password management events within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for saving login parameters, handling forgotten passwords, showing password hints, sending password reset emails, and checking login status.

classes.name: LoginEvents
classes.description: Handles user login, password hint, and reset events within the OFBiz security extension.

methods.name: saveEntryParams
methods.description: Saves USERNAME and PASSWORD parameters into the user session, lowercasing them if configured to do so.

methods.name: forgotPassword
methods.description: Handles user requests to recover password hints or email password reset links.

methods.name: showPasswordHint
methods.description: Retrieves and displays the password hint for the specified user login ID.

methods.name: emailPasswordRequest
methods.description: Initiates the process to email the user a password reset link, generating a JWT token, and sending an email based on store settings.

methods.name: storeCheckLogin
methods.description: Checks user login status and verifies store customer role.

methods.name: storeLogin
methods.description: Performs user login and verifies store customer role, returning appropriate status.
